login.title: Login
login.subtitle: Continue your German learning journey.

register.title: Start learning German
register.subtitle: No credit card required · Start free, with a daily AI practice allowance.
register.terms: By signing up, you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
register.phoneInvalid: This is not a valid Vietnamese mobile number — it needs 10 digits and must start with 03, 05, 07, 08 or 09
register.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
register.failed: Could not create the account. Please try again.
register.humanCheckPending: We are checking that you are a real person. Please wait a few seconds and try again.
register.humanCheckFailed: We could not confirm that you are a real person. Please try again.
register.humanCheckLoadFailed: The verification step could not load. Turn off your ad blocker for this page or try another browser.
register.emailDisposable: Temporary email addresses are not accepted. Please use the email you use every day.

forgot.requestSubtitle: Enter the email you use to log in. If it has an account, we'll send a 6-digit code so you can set a new password.
forgot.requestFailed: Could not send the code. Please try again.
forgot.sentNotice: If {email} has a myDeutschFlow account, a 6-digit code is on its way. It is valid for 15 minutes.
forgot.resetSubtitle: Your new password replaces the old one. Every signed-in device will need to log in again.
forgot.newPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
forgot.resetFailed: Could not reset the password. Please try again.
forgot.success: Password reset. Please sign in again.
forgot.privacyNote: To protect you, we never reveal whether an email has an account. The next screen looks the same for every email.
forgot.resent: If this email has an account, a new code is on its way.
forgot.noMailHint: No email after a few minutes? Check the address you entered, look in Spam, or <link>create a new account</link>.
forgot.codeRejected: The code is incorrect or has expired.
forgot.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

activate.title: Set your password
activate.subtitle: This is your first time on DeutschFlow. Choose a password to use from now on.
activate.accountNotice: You are setting the password for {email}.
activate.accountNoticeWithOrg: You are setting the password for {email}, created by {org}.
activate.newPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
activate.confirmMismatch: The two passwords do not match
activate.success: Password set. Sign in to begin.
activate.failed: Could not set the password. Please try again.
activate.expired: This activation link has expired. You can still get in with “Forgot password”.
activate.used: This link has already been used. Sign in with the password you set, or use “Forgot password” if you cannot remember it.
activate.unknown: This activation link is not valid. Check the email again, or use “Forgot password”.

verify.resent: A new code was sent to {email}.
verify.resendFailed: We could not resend the code. Please try again.
verify.spamHint: No email? Check your Spam or Promotions folder. It comes from {sender}.
verify.wrong: The code is incorrect or has expired.
verify.wrongWithRemaining: {count, plural, one {Incorrect code. You have 1 attempt left.} other {Incorrect code. You have # attempts left.}}
verify.locked: Too many incorrect attempts. Tap "Resend code" to get a new one.
verify.expired: The code has expired. Tap "Resend code" to get a new one.
verify.accountExists: This email now has an account. Log in, or use "Forgot password".
verify.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
verify.sendFailed: We could not send the verification code. Please try again in a few minutes.
